title: Let's build a Chatbot - Multiple Auth Providers (Auth0) (Part 16)

cues.en: Hi, and welcome to part 16 of Let's Build a Chatbot in C-Sharp using Microsoft Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到使用 C# 與 Microsoft Agent Framework 打造聊天機器人的第十六部分。

cues.en: In this video, I'm going to tackle something I have been annoyed by for a while, and that
cues.zh: 這支影片要解決困擾我一陣子的事情，

cues.en: is that, yes, I built a chatbot, but I couldn't really share it with anyone unless I actually put them into my Microsoft intro ID.
cues.zh: 雖然已經建立聊天機器人，但除非把別人加入我的 Microsoft Entra ID，否則無法分享給他們。

cues.en: So essentially, what we built in some videos ago was an internal login.
cues.zh: 所以前幾支影片建立的，基本上只是內部登入。

cues.en: So for that reason, I have put in multiple providers, both as an education, but also
cues.zh: 因此這次加入多個驗證供應商，一方面作為教學，另一方面，

cues.en: as an option to put in multiple of these in here.
cues.zh: 也讓系統能選擇使用不同供應商。

cues.en: So I put in Auth0 as well, which if you have done any kind of login, you probably know, in order to make social logins as well.
cues.zh: 我加入了 Auth0。如果做過登入，應該很熟悉它，可以提供社群帳號登入。

cues.en: So let's have a look at it.
cues.zh: 接著看看。

cues.en: We won't go too much into the code.
cues.zh: 不會太深入介紹程式碼。

cues.en: It's mostly generated by AI anyway, but just to understand what's going on, let's jump
cues.zh: 反正大部分也是 AI 產生的，但為了理解運作方式，先進入，

cues.en: into the system.
cues.zh: 系統。

cues.en: And the system has gotten some new parameters here.
cues.zh: 系統現在多了一些參數。

cues.en: We need 4 for Auth0, we need a callback, and we need a client ID, a secret ID, and a domain.
cues.zh: Auth0 需要四項：Callback、Client ID、Client Secret 與 Domain。

cues.en: And you get those by logging into your Auth0, and you can just make a free account.
cues.zh: 登入 Auth0 就能取得，也可以免費建立帳號。

cues.en: No need to pay anything in order to do this.
cues.zh: 這個用途不需要付費。

cues.en: And then you go in and build an application.
cues.zh: 接著建立一個應用程式。

cues.en: And once you have an application, you get your domain, your client ID, and your client secret, and that's what we need to put in there.
cues.zh: 建立後會取得 Domain、Client ID 與 Client Secret，把它們填到這裡。

cues.en: So what I've done up here is essentially just made the application called a chatbot, gotten
cues.zh: 我這裡只是建立名為 Chatbot 的應用程式，取得，

cues.en: these three values that it may also generate, and then put in callback URLs down here for
cues.zh: 自動產生的三個值，再於下面加入 Callback URL，

cues.en: login and logout, and then fill out web origins.
cues.zh: 用於登入與登出，也填入 Web Origins。

cues.en: This is just a regular web application.
cues.zh: 應用程式類型是一般 Web Application。

cues.en: And then I went into authentication and chose social, and set up that it could log in with
cues.zh: 接著到 Authentication，選擇 Social，設定可以使用，

cues.en: GitHub, Google Auth, and Windows, meaning Windows private accounts.
cues.zh: GitHub、Google，以及 Windows，也就是個人的 Microsoft 帳號登入。

cues.en: Entry ID will take care of the other things.
cues.zh: 其他企業身分則由 Entra ID 處理。

cues.en: So all of these have not really been set up to other than development.
cues.zh: 目前這些設定都只用於開發。

cues.en: There is more work to be done in order to go into production, but we won't be covering that here.
cues.zh: 正式上線還需要更多設定，不過這裡不介紹。

cues.en: That will mostly be documentation about Auth0, how you set all these things up.
cues.zh: 主要參考 Auth0 文件，了解如何設定各項內容。

cues.en: So all of these are just press next and nothing more.
cues.zh: 目前大致都只要按下一步。

cues.en: So once we have those, we can put them in.
cues.zh: 取得這些值後，就可以填入參數。

cues.en: But I've also taken care of that, for example, if you don't want to use Auth0, you can write
cues.zh: 我也處理了不想使用 Auth0 的情況，只要在，

cues.en: the word none in all these fields, and it will disable Auth0.
cues.zh: 所有欄位填入 none，就會停用 Auth0。

cues.en: And in the same manner, we have Entry ID, I've moved it into parameters here instead of being in the app.
cues.zh: 同樣地，Entra ID 設定也移到這裡的參數，不再放在應用程式內。

cues.en: Let me find it here.
cues.zh: 找一下原本的位置。

cues.en: This video, it was in app settings here.
cues.zh: 之前那支影片放在這裡的 AppSettings。

cues.en: Those app settings are now gone, and then put down into being in system, so we can configure
cues.zh: 現在移除那些設定，改成集中放在系統參數中，方便，

cues.en: everything in one place.
cues.zh: 統一管理。

cues.en: And again, you can put in none in all of these, but you need to choose at least one of them.
cues.zh: 這邊也能全部填入 none，但兩種供應商至少需要選一種。

cues.en: Put it in the comments if you feel like we should have none in both, and it should be a local login.
cues.zh: 如果覺得應該允許兩者都停用、改成本機登入，可以留言告訴我。

cues.en: Let's see what we can do here.
cues.zh: 接著看看實際操作。

cues.en: Right now I'm logged in, but I can log out.
cues.zh: 目前已登入，不過可以登出。

cues.en: And because I have both enabled, I've made this little screen in order to log in with either Auth0 or Entry ID.
cues.zh: 因為兩個供應商都啟用，所以加入這個小畫面，選擇 Auth0 或 Entra ID 登入。

cues.en: Because at some point I want to plan to actually host this chatbot, so you can try it out using some more data.
cues.zh: 我打算之後實際託管這個聊天機器人，讓你能用更多資料試用。

cues.en: Because you would normally go to chat-gbt, but my idea at the moment is that I want to
cues.zh: 一般情況你可能直接使用 ChatGPT，但我目前的想法是，

cues.en: do RAC on all my videos up in the YouTube channel, in order for you to have a chatbot
cues.zh: 把 YouTube 頻道上的所有影片加入 RAG，打造聊天機器人，

cues.en: where you can actually ask about different topics in Agent Framework and be led to the right videos. That's my plan.
cues.zh: 讓你詢問 Agent Framework 相關主題，並引導到正確影片。這是目前計畫。

cues.en: And that's also one of the reasons why I put in the various server settings in order to disable things like image generation at that point.
cues.zh: 這也是加入各種伺服器設定的原因，屆時可以停用圖像生成等功能。

cues.en: And I will then be allowed to use Entry ID to log in with just normal login methods here.
cues.zh: 我自己可以使用 Entra ID，以一般的方式登入。

cues.en: So I can log in here and get in.
cues.zh: 在這裡登入，就能進入。

cues.en: But everyone else will be allowed to use, let me jump in here again, the Auth0 here.
cues.zh: 其他人則可以，先回到這裡，使用 Auth0。

cues.en: In Auth0, we get this screen where you have four different options.
cues.zh: Auth0 會顯示這個畫面，提供四種選擇。

cues.en: You can either sign up for just a username and password, or use your Google account, GitHub account, or Microsoft account.
cues.zh: 可以註冊使用者名稱與密碼，或使用 Google、GitHub、Microsoft 帳號。

cues.en: And I haven't really written any code in order to do that.
cues.zh: 為了提供這些選項，我幾乎沒有寫任何程式碼。

cues.en: That's the beauty of Auth0.
cues.zh: 這就是 Auth0 方便的地方。

cues.en: If I want to log in with my GitHub, I can do that.
cues.zh: 例如想用 GitHub 登入，直接選擇。

cues.en: Normally, it will pop up with authorized login information, but I have already authorized here, so I just need to accept.
cues.zh: 正常會出現授權登入資訊，但我已經授權，因此只需要接受。

cues.en: And now I'm in with my GitHub.
cues.zh: 現在已用 GitHub 身分登入。

cues.en: I can go back and switch and go in with my username and password here, or I can go in
cues.zh: 也可以回去切換，使用帳號密碼，或，

cues.en: and choose one of the others.
cues.zh: 選擇其他供應商。

cues.en: And behind the scenes, users are being created up here, all with the same, almost the same email address.
cues.zh: 背後會在這裡建立使用者，這些帳號使用相同或幾乎相同的電子郵件。

cues.en: I have multiple, but you can see they are from various different things, username and password, GitHub, Google, or Windows.
cues.zh: 我有多個地址，但可以看到，來源分別是帳號密碼、GitHub、Google 或 Windows。

cues.en: So I can control who is here.
cues.zh: 因此能管理有哪些使用者。

cues.en: That's being passed on through those different social models.
cues.zh: 各種社群登入方式會把身分資訊傳過來。

cues.en: We'll look a little about the code.
cues.zh: 稍微看看程式碼。

cues.en: Again, we won't go into too much of it, but in the app host, we now have a bunch of extra
cues.zh: 同樣不深入，但 AppHost 現在有更多，

cues.en: environments for Auth0 and the EnterID.
cues.zh: Auth0 與 Entra ID 的環境設定。

cues.en: And then in program, I have put in authentication, but with the two authenticators that we can
cues.zh: Program 中則加入驗證，設定兩種，

cues.en: use, and I put that up in authorization.
cues.zh: 可使用的驗證方式，並放在 Authorization 設定中。

cues.en: So if you need to look at the Auth0 part, it's in this folder, and if it's the EnterID, it's in this folder.
cues.zh: Auth0 相關內容在這個資料夾，Entra ID 則在另一個。

cues.en: This is the CRBits, where we generate the little screen about being logged in with one or the other.
cues.zh: 這些元件負責產生小畫面，選擇使用哪種登入。

cues.en: So they either have log in from Auth0 or log in from Entra, and there's a few endpoints
cues.zh: 因此可以走 Auth0 或 Entra 登入，也有幾個端點，

cues.en: that need to be set up, and here we have the screen that we can choose our provider.
cues.zh: 需要設定，這裡則是選擇供應商的畫面。

cues.en: So the endpoints are various things in order for us to log in.
cues.zh: 這些端點負責不同登入操作。

cues.en: Again, this is default authentication stuff.
cues.zh: 再次強調，這些都是標準驗證功能。

cues.en: I'm not very strong in that area, but luckily my anti-codex is, so it helped me a lot building this part.
cues.zh: 我不擅長這個領域，但幸好 Codex 很熟，幫了很多忙。

cues.en: But now we have authentication, and we only need one more video in this series for this
cues.zh: 現在驗證已經完成，這一階段只剩下一支影片，

cues.en: time around, and so we go to other backends and frontends, and that is the actual deployment, which is in the next video.
cues.zh: 接著就會進入其他前後端。最後一支就是實際部署。

cues.en: So see you there.
cues.zh: 到時見。
